name: agent_compat
description: Run deterministic Phase 0 compatibility simulations between stub digital twins and emit a spec-conformant report with outcomes, repair metrics, friction evidence, transcripts, and sycophancy diagnostics. The project is spec-first; this CLI is the reference runner, not a matching score.
status: phase-0; founding spec and runner are intentionally unstable

exit_codes.0: report produced and passes the enforced R6 no-single-score validation
exit_codes.1: report produced but violates R6 validation
exit_codes.2: scenario input is unreadable/invalid or the report cannot be written

scenario.description: Optional path to a structured markdown scenario file. Omit to run the bundled demo.

out.description: Optional path for the JSON report. Omit to print the report to stdout.

output_contract.stdout: When --out is omitted, stdout is the full report JSON.
output_contract.normative_rule: Reports must not contain a top-level scalar compatibility score, match score, rating, grade, or verdict.

audience_notes.agents: Start here for command shape and exit-code semantics, then read the linked specs. Do not infer or invent a single compatibility score.
audience_notes.humans: Start with README.md and docs/PRD.md for product scope, contribution surfaces, and the Phase 0 wedge.
